newsitem.title: FINLAND: AMER SELLS CAR DEALERS FOR FIM 320 MLN.
newsitem.headline: AMER SELLS CAR DEALERS FOR FIM 320 MLN.

text.p: Finnish tobacco and sporting goods group Amer Oy said in a statement on Monday it had sold its Citroen and Suzuki car dealing operations to Oy Veho Ab and its car leasing operations to Hertz Leasing Oy.
"The total consideration due for these transactions is 320 million markka," Amer said.
"As a result of these disposals, Amer's 1996 results will include an extraordinary profit of approximately 20 million markka," it said.
The net sales of the two units sold were expected to total 475 million markka in January-November, it said.
All 110 employees would transfer to the new owners, it said.
The Citroen and Suzuki importer and retailer Auto-Bon Oy would continue operations in its old premises and operate under the same name, Amer said.
Amer said the disposals were part of its strategy to focus on its sporting goods division and improve profitability there.
"During the current year, the Sports Division's net sales are expected to represent 75 percent of group net sales," it said.
